objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: capacity>=2 Ah (stage2), 5C retention>=95% (stage2, 5C/1C ratio), power density>=4000 W/kg (stage2, V_OC^2/(4 DCR)/mass), no plating at 4C charge (stage3, anode_potential_v>=0 V), T_max<=333.15 K (stage3). Main trade-off: thin/porous electrodes buy retention+power+low-T but sacrifice 1C capacity -> co-optimize against the 2 Ah floor; V^2 lever (high-voltage system) is the escalation reserve for power density.
candidate_strategy: Round 1 baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C SPMe/DFN, 5C DFN, 4C 45C lumped+plating, calc-energy) as ceiling anchor; opening ceiling assessment vs objective; rounds 2+ architecture exploration 2-4/round (thickness+porosity capacity-guarded by 2 Ah; particle size down; electrolyte sigma/t+/D formulation overrides literature-sourced; collector/separator slimming; cooling h as T_max lever); plating fix order: negative thin+small particles+N/P -> electrolyte transport -> Stage-2 system escalation.
budget_allocation: R1: 4 run-pyamm + calc-energy + evaluate. Exploration: <=4 rounds x 3 candidates x (1C SPMe + 5C DFN + 4C SPMe) + calc-energy, DFN reference only for finalists. Closing: endorse(skip real_compute=false)+final+render+deliverables. Stop: all five metrics pass or budget/harness exhausted (honest final).
risk_and_fallback: R1 retention likely <<95% (thick baseline electrodes) -> Stage 3 thin/porous/small-particle. Capacity drops <2 Ah -> re-thicken to areal floor. Plating persists -> negative design then electrolyte then Stage 2 system switch. T_max>333.15 -> resistance cut + h raise. Power<4000 -> DCR*mass attack (collector/sep share). Three strikes -> layer-by-layer questioning (system/boundary/metric) before any negative close.
